claims.text: The waiting window runs from the driver's arrival at 09:10:45 to his cancellation at 09:16:05, and inside that window the chat log carries a locating message from the rider: MSG-00405-002, sent 09:11:40, delivered 09:11:41, reading 'im at blk 12 void deck, cant see any car, where r u?'. It names the rider's own position (blk 12 void deck), states she cannot see the vehicle, and asks the driver for his position. That is limb (a) of POL-NS-04 satisfied on the face of the record.

Limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is satisfied. The 120 second window after 09:11:40 closed at 09:13:40; the driver posted no reply at any point before terminating the trip at 09:16:05, 265 seconds after the message, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no in-app voice call was placed either. The chat export's read receipt shows the driver opened the message at 09:11:55, ten seconds after it was sent, and still did not answer it.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is satisfied on the rider's own track. rider_presence is available with 36 fixes, all 36 of them qualifying, spanning 09:10:45 to 09:16:00 - the whole waiting window - and every one of them lies within the 100 m rider-presence radius for this STANDARD zone pickup (max_distance_m 45.15 m, mean_distance_m 41.01 m, min_distance_m 36.23 m). Not one rider fix falls outside the radius, so the majority-of-qualifying-fixes requirement is met many times over.

With limbs (a), (b) and (c) all made out, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider and refunds the cancellation fee in full, with no driver compensation payable. POL-NS-01 chargeability is displaced by that clause, and the fare breakdown shows SGD 4.00 charged at 09:16:20 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the whole contested SGD 4.00 is returned to the filing rider under POL-GEN-03.

The driver's statement that he waited over five minutes and that 'she never came down' does not answer POL-NS-04 and is partly contradicted by his own evidence. His trace does confirm the 320 second wait, but the rider's device sits within 45 m of the pickup pin for the entire window, and the driver read the rider's message at 09:11:55 and never told her where he was standing. POL-NS-04 turns on the unanswered locating message, not on the length of the driver's wait.

Nothing on this record diverts the case to human review instead of a ruling. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not trip; those are the only profile fields I cite, and only for the tests POL-GEN-01 names them for. Every artifact the rider's case rests on - chat log, GPS trace, trip record, fare breakdown - is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap on the deciding facts is 1.0 and the 0.70 escalation floor is not engaged.

I do not press the arithmetic routes, and I concede them. The measured in-geofence dwell is 320 seconds against the 300 second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD pickup (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a surplus of 20 seconds, so POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing. Nor is the arrival marker false: it is a BUTTON press at 09:10:45, and that timestamp is the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so POL-NS-05's tests - more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or more at the marker - are not met on this trace. The rider's case rests on POL-NS-04 alone.

The only artifact in this bundle below weight 1.0 is EV-ADVIS-00405-01, the traffic advisory for the pickup road, which is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, no payload): no advisory covers Bedok South Rd in this window. I disclose that impairment. It carries no fact for either side and decides nothing the rider's case rests on; under POL-NS-06 limb (i) its absence merely denies the driver any kerbside-accumulation argument, and the rider does not need the point.

Every limb of POL-NS-01 is made out on this record. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 09:10:45, corroborated by the platform's own 'Your driver has arrived' notice delivered to the rider at 09:10:46. (b) The driver's trace is already inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that same second - his closest approach to the pickup pin is 3.7 m and 33 fixes qualify inside the radius - so the clock runs from geofence entry, not from a late tap. (c) He then held position for one continuous 320 second interval, which exceeds the 300 second free waiting period the trip record's own platform_policy carries (not the 180 second default), and platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies. (d) The trip shows no boarding and was terminated by the driver at 09:16:05, after the required dwell had run, under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three reason codes limb (d) recognises. The cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable.

The arrival geofence test in POL-NS-02 is satisfied on the trace itself and not inferred: the pickup zone class is STANDARD, so the radius is 50 m, and the derived arrival block records 33 qualifying fixes inside that radius with a minimum distance of 3.7 m - far more than the three consecutive in-radius fixes the clause requires. This is not a driver who sat outside the radius, and because his stationary fixes lie inside the radius rather than between the radius and 400 m, the wrong-entrance regime of POL-NS-03 is not engaged either and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises.

POL-NS-05 raises no false-arrival point against this driver. The fastest speed anywhere on his trace is 10.6 km/h, below the clause's 15 km/h motion threshold, and his closest approach is 3.7 m from the pin, far inside the 300 m line, so the marker at 09:10:45 is true. Consistently with that, dwell_start_offset_sec is 0.0: his first in-geofence fix and the marker fall in the same second, so there is no recomputed clock that shortens the dwell.

POL-NS-06 gives the rider no route on these facts: the effective in-geofence dwell is a single unbroken run of 320 seconds against the 300 second minimum for this zone class, and the derived shortfall is minus 20.0 seconds, that is a surplus and not a deficit. There is no premature cancellation, and the full refund that clause would order on a shortfall cannot be ordered here.

The money line carries no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is 4.00, which is exactly the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd in force for this trip under the resolution rule, and the ledger shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The amount the driver asks to stand is the amount the platform itself charged.

On a verified no-show the driver's payout is fixed by POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the fee in force: SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 net figure carried by the fare breakdown. The anti-farming check does not trip on the only two fields the clause permits it to read - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the absolute threshold of 4, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008, below the 0.08 rate - so compensation is payable rather than withheld, and no escalation follows from that check.

No other escalation ground in POL-NS-09 is shown on the profiles: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and both rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so limbs (c) and (d) are not engaged and nothing in this case requires the fee to be held rather than decided.

The only impaired artifact in the bundle is the traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00405-01, which is MISSING and carries weight 0.0 - I disclose that rather than present it as clean. It bears only on POL-NS-06(i), the limb that permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed when a qualifying advisory covers the pickup road: limb (i) is therefore unavailable on this record, but the driver does not need it, because his 320 second dwell is one continuous run (run_count 1) that requires no accumulation.

The disposition of the fee that this evidence supports is party-relative under POL-GEN-03: the dispute is rider-filed and the charge still stands on the ledger, so the fee is left as it presently is (NO_ACTION as to the fee), and the outcome the case produces is the driver's compensation of SGD 3.20 under POL-NS-07, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd.

The driver does not dispute the chat record: the rider's 09:11:40 message was delivered, read at 09:11:55, and answered neither in the log nor by any in-app call recorded in the trip record, and her own device track stays within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius throughout. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) to (c) are therefore made out on the face of the evidence, and the driver's case rests on his own arrival and dwell arithmetic under POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-07 as set out above, which stand unless the judge finds POL-NS-04 displaces them.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver. This is the rider-filed dispute over the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00405.

WHAT THE DRIVER'S EVIDENCE SHOWS, AND IT IS MOSTLY RIGHT. The driver's arrival arithmetic holds up. EV-GPS-00405 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 09:10:45, with a closest approach of 3.7 m and 33 qualifying in-radius fixes; EV-TRIP-00405 carries his 'arrived' event at 09:10:45 and, in its own platform_policy block, a free_wait_sec of 300 seconds (not the 180-second default). He then held position for one continuous 320-second run. So POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) are made out: arrived event, in-geofence at the marker, dwell 320 s against the 300 s required, no boarding, and termination under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing, because the derived shortfall is minus 20.0 seconds, a surplus rather than a deficit. POL-NS-05 gives her nothing either: the fastest speed anywhere on the driver's trace is 10.6 km/h, below the 15 km/h motion threshold, and the marker sits 3.7 m from the pin, far inside the 300 m line, with dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0 — the marker is true. POL-NS-03 is not engaged, because his stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not between the radius and 400 m, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. And POL-NS-08(d) shows no money defect: the fare_breakdown line of SGD 4.00 is exactly the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.00 in force for this trip. I accept every one of those driver claims.

WHY THE RIDER STILL WINS: POL-NS-04. POL-NS-04 is in the range of clauses POL-NS-01 itself says displace it, and it is satisfied on the face of the record on all three limbs. (a) EV-CHAT-00405 shows the rider sent, at 09:11:40 — inside the waiting window that ran from the 09:10:45 arrival to the 09:16:05 cancellation — the message 'im at blk 12 void deck, cant see any car, where r u?'. It names her block, states she cannot see the vehicle, and asks for the driver's position. (b) The driver posted no reply at any point before terminating the trip, and EV-TRIP-00405's in_app_calls list is empty, so no in-app voice call was placed; his read receipt at 09:11:55 shows he opened the message ten seconds after it arrived and still did not answer. (c) The rider's own device track in EV-GPS-00405 (rider_presence) runs 36 qualifying fixes across the whole window, every one of them inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius — furthest 45.15 m, mean 41.01 m, nearest 36.23 m — so the majority requirement is met many times over. POL-NS-04 therefore exonerates the rider, refunds the cancellation fee in full, and states that no driver compensation is payable. His own advocate conceded these limbs and rested the driver's case on POL-NS-01 not being displaced; it is displaced.

THE DRIVER'S PAYOUT CLAIM IS REJECTED. His claim for SGD 3.20 (80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee under POL-NS-07) fails because POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full AND no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. POL-NS-04 displaces it, so the payout is not reached. His anti-farming submission is correct as far as it goes — 1 no-show termination in 30 days against 120 completed trips, a rate of 0.008, neither limb of the check trips — but the check decides nothing once the fee itself does not stand. His POL-GEN-03 submission (leave the fee standing, pay the driver) is rejected for the same reason: the fee does not stand, so there is nothing to leave in place.

NO ESCALATION, AND THE PROFILES DO NOT DECIDE ANYTHING. No profile field outside POL-GEN-01's citable list is used for any test. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so limbs (c) and (d) are not engaged, and the anti-farming limb is not engaged. On the driver's statement and the counterparty statement: I accept that the driver waited over five minutes — his trace confirms the 320-second dwell — but neither the length of the wait nor his statement that 'she never came down' answers POL-NS-04, which turns on the unanswered locating message, not on the wait. His statement carries no weight multiplier and does not meet the clause's test.

IMPAIRED ARTIFACT. The only artifact below weight 1.0 is EV-ADVIS-00405-01, the traffic advisory for the pickup road: MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0. I name it because POL-GEN-02(3) requires it. It carries no fact either side needs — its absence only denies the driver the kerbside-accumulation argument in POL-NS-06(i), which he did not need because his dwell is one continuous 320-second run. Every fact this ruling rests on is carried by artifacts at weight 1.0 (EV-CHAT-00405, EV-GPS-00405, EV-TRIP-00405), so the confidence cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 escalation floor is not engaged.

MONEY AND DISPOSITION. The fee charged is SGD 4.00 (EV-FARE-00405; payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The rider receives the whole contested SGD 4.00 back. Driver compensation is nil, because POL-NS-04 does not pay it. No clause on these facts produces a referral, so the referrals list is empty. The monetary effect, SGD 4.00, is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold and executes on issue. This ruling was made without human review; either party may appeal it under POL-GEN-04.

No referral arises either: POL-NS-05(ii) fires only on a false arrival marker, and the marker here is true. Weight and confidence: the only artifact below full weight is the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00405-01, which is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, no payload); it decides nothing, because it would bear only on POL-NS-06(i) accumulation and the driver's 320 second dwell is a single run, and it is not the sole evidence for any deciding fact. The deciding facts rest on the chat log, trip record and GPS trace, each COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and my confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. (The driver's earlier claim about that advisory was discarded by the referee for not naming the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT.) The defect that decides this case is not the driver's arrival or his wait, which are immaculate, but his unanswered message. Ruling: FULL_REFUND of SGD 4.00 to the rider, no driver compensation, no referrals. The monetary effect is SGD 4.00, below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically unless either party appeals under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver, in plain language.

OUTCOME: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-00405 is refunded to the rider in full, and no compensation is paid to the driver.

WHAT IS SETTLED. The driver accepted at 09:05:35 and the platform's GPS trace (EV-GPS-00405) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 09:10:45 and holds him there in one unbroken stationary run of 320 seconds until 09:16:05 (closest approach 3.72 m; 33 qualifying in-radius fixes). The 300 second free waiting period the trip record itself carries was therefore served (a surplus of 20 seconds), and the trip was ended by the driver under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The driver's account - that he was at the block for over five minutes - is borne out as to the wait. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-00405) shows SGD 4.00 charged, matching the fee in force, so there is no money-line defect under POL-NS-08(d). The driver's statement that 'she never came down' is not borne out: his conclusion is contradicted by the rider's own device track, which is what POL-NS-04 makes its test; that statement carries no weight multiplier of its own.

WHY THE FEE IS REFUNDED ANYWAY. POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider where three conditions hold, and each is satisfied here.
(a) During the waiting window the rider sent a locating/coordinating message - MSG-00405-002, sent 09:11:40, delivered 09:11:41: 'im at blk 12 void deck, cant see any car, where r u?'. It names her own position, states she cannot see the vehicle, and asks for the driver's position.
(b) The driver neither replied nor called. The 120 second window after that message closed at 09:13:40; the export (EV-CHAT-00405) holds only the platform's own 'Your driver has arrived' notice and the rider's message; trip_record.in_app_calls is empty; and the cancellation came 265 seconds after the message, at 09:16:05. The read receipt shows the driver opened the message at 09:11:55 and did not answer it.
(c) The rider's device track is present and usable - 36 fixes from 09:10:45 to 09:16:00, all 36 qualifying - and every fix lies inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius (furthest 45.15 m, mean 41.01 m, nearest 36.23 m).

THE DRIVER'S CASE AND ITS EFFECT. POL-NS-01 is satisfied limb by limb as the driver argues: arrival event at 09:10:45 (a); in-radius fixes at that same second (b); 320 seconds of continuous dwell against the 300 second minimum in force (c); and a driver-terminated RIDER_NO_SHOW cancellation at or after the dwell elapsed (d), no_show_threshold_sec being null. But limb satisfaction makes the fee chargeable only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 does. The driver's claim for SGD 3.20 under POL-NS-07 (80 percent of the SGD 4.00 net figure) is therefore declined, and his request for a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling with amount_sgd mirroring that figure is refused. The anti-farming check would not have tripped in any event (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d 1, below 4; 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d 120 = 0.008, below 0.08), but it does not arise because the fee does not stand.

THE REMAINING POINTS. POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-03: accepted - the driver did arrive inside the radius, so this is not a wrong-entrance case and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-05: accepted - the arrival marker is true (fastest speed on the trace 10.6 km/h, under the 15 km/h threshold; closest approach 3.72 m, far inside 300 m; dwell_start_offset 0.0), so no false-arrival referral is recorded. POL-NS-06: accepted - there is no shortfall (320 s measured against 300 s required), so it gives the rider nothing and the driver needs no accumulation argument. POL-NS-09: accepted - rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d fields are 0, so no escalation ground is engaged; those are the only profile fields used, and only for the tests POL-GEN-01 names them for. The rider's concessions on POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 are noted and correct. The driver's closing submission - that the message was delivered, read and unanswered and the rider's track stayed inside the radius, and that his case stands unless POL-NS-04 displaces it - is correctly stated, and POL-NS-04 does displace it.

IMPAIRMENT AND CONFIDENCE. The only artifact below full weight is the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00405-01, which is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0). It carries no fact this ruling rests on: the driver's 320 second dwell is a single continuous run, so accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is unnecessary, and no party relies on it. The deciding facts are carried by EV-CHAT-00405, EV-TRIP-00405 and EV-GPS-00405, all at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor, so the case does not escalate.

EXECUTION. The monetary effect is SGD 4.00, at or below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so the refund executes on issue. Either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ledger.claim: The waiting window runs from the driver's arrival at 09:10:45 to his cancellation at 09:16:05, and inside that window the chat log carries a locating message from the rider: MSG-00405-002, sent 09:11:40, delivered 09:11:41, reading 'im at blk 12 void deck, cant see any car, where r u?'. It names the rider's own position (blk 12 void deck), states she cannot see the vehicle, and asks the driver for his position. That is limb (a) of POL-NS-04 satisfied on the face of the record.

Limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is satisfied. The 120 second window after 09:11:40 closed at 09:13:40; the driver posted no reply at any point before terminating the trip at 09:16:05, 265 seconds after the message, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no in-app voice call was placed either. The chat export's read receipt shows the driver opened the message at 09:11:55, ten seconds after it was sent, and still did not answer it.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is satisfied on the rider's own track. rider_presence is available with 36 fixes, all 36 of them qualifying, spanning 09:10:45 to 09:16:00 - the whole waiting window - and every one of them lies within the 100 m rider-presence radius for this STANDARD zone pickup (max_distance_m 45.15 m, mean_distance_m 41.01 m, min_distance_m 36.23 m). Not one rider fix falls outside the radius, so the majority-of-qualifying-fixes requirement is met many times over.

With limbs (a), (b) and (c) all made out, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider and refunds the cancellation fee in full, with no driver compensation payable. POL-NS-01 chargeability is displaced by that clause, and the fare breakdown shows SGD 4.00 charged at 09:16:20 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the whole contested SGD 4.00 is returned to the filing rider under POL-GEN-03.

The driver's statement that he waited over five minutes and that 'she never came down' does not answer POL-NS-04 and is partly contradicted by his own evidence. His trace does confirm the 320 second wait, but the rider's device sits within 45 m of the pickup pin for the entire window, and the driver read the rider's message at 09:11:55 and never told her where he was standing. POL-NS-04 turns on the unanswered locating message, not on the length of the driver's wait.

Nothing on this record diverts the case to human review instead of a ruling. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not trip; those are the only profile fields I cite, and only for the tests POL-GEN-01 names them for. Every artifact the rider's case rests on - chat log, GPS trace, trip record, fare breakdown - is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap on the deciding facts is 1.0 and the 0.70 escalation floor is not engaged.

I do not press the arithmetic routes, and I concede them. The measured in-geofence dwell is 320 seconds against the 300 second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD pickup (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a surplus of 20 seconds, so POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing. Nor is the arrival marker false: it is a BUTTON press at 09:10:45, and that timestamp is the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so POL-NS-05's tests - more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or more at the marker - are not met on this trace. The rider's case rests on POL-NS-04 alone.

The only artifact in this bundle below weight 1.0 is EV-ADVIS-00405-01, the traffic advisory for the pickup road, which is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, no payload): no advisory covers Bedok South Rd in this window. I disclose that impairment. It carries no fact for either side and decides nothing the rider's case rests on; under POL-NS-06 limb (i) its absence merely denies the driver any kerbside-accumulation argument, and the rider does not need the point.

Every limb of POL-NS-01 is made out on this record. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 09:10:45, corroborated by the platform's own 'Your driver has arrived' notice delivered to the rider at 09:10:46. (b) The driver's trace is already inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that same second - his closest approach to the pickup pin is 3.7 m and 33 fixes qualify inside the radius - so the clock runs from geofence entry, not from a late tap. (c) He then held position for one continuous 320 second interval, which exceeds the 300 second free waiting period the trip record's own platform_policy carries (not the 180 second default), and platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies. (d) The trip shows no boarding and was terminated by the driver at 09:16:05, after the required dwell had run, under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three reason codes limb (d) recognises. The cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable.

The arrival geofence test in POL-NS-02 is satisfied on the trace itself and not inferred: the pickup zone class is STANDARD, so the radius is 50 m, and the derived arrival block records 33 qualifying fixes inside that radius with a minimum distance of 3.7 m - far more than the three consecutive in-radius fixes the clause requires. This is not a driver who sat outside the radius, and because his stationary fixes lie inside the radius rather than between the radius and 400 m, the wrong-entrance regime of POL-NS-03 is not engaged either and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises.

POL-NS-05 raises no false-arrival point against this driver. The fastest speed anywhere on his trace is 10.6 km/h, below the clause's 15 km/h motion threshold, and his closest approach is 3.7 m from the pin, far inside the 300 m line, so the marker at 09:10:45 is true. Consistently with that, dwell_start_offset_sec is 0.0: his first in-geofence fix and the marker fall in the same second, so there is no recomputed clock that shortens the dwell.

POL-NS-06 gives the rider no route on these facts: the effective in-geofence dwell is a single unbroken run of 320 seconds against the 300 second minimum for this zone class, and the derived shortfall is minus 20.0 seconds, that is a surplus and not a deficit. There is no premature cancellation, and the full refund that clause would order on a shortfall cannot be ordered here.

The money line carries no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is 4.00, which is exactly the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd in force for this trip under the resolution rule, and the ledger shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The amount the driver asks to stand is the amount the platform itself charged.

On a verified no-show the driver's payout is fixed by POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the fee in force: SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 net figure carried by the fare breakdown. The anti-farming check does not trip on the only two fields the clause permits it to read - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the absolute threshold of 4, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008, below the 0.08 rate - so compensation is payable rather than withheld, and no escalation follows from that check.

No other escalation ground in POL-NS-09 is shown on the profiles: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and both rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so limbs (c) and (d) are not engaged and nothing in this case requires the fee to be held rather than decided.

The only impaired artifact in the bundle is the traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00405-01, which is MISSING and carries weight 0.0 - I disclose that rather than present it as clean. It bears only on POL-NS-06(i), the limb that permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed when a qualifying advisory covers the pickup road: limb (i) is therefore unavailable on this record, but the driver does not need it, because his 320 second dwell is one continuous run (run_count 1) that requires no accumulation.

ledger.claim: The disposition of the fee that this evidence supports is party-relative under POL-GEN-03: the dispute is rider-filed and the charge still stands on the ledger, so the fee is left as it presently is (NO_ACTION as to the fee), and the outcome the case produces is the driver's compensation of SGD 3.20 under POL-NS-07, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd.

The driver does not dispute the chat record: the rider's 09:11:40 message was delivered, read at 09:11:55, and answered neither in the log nor by any in-app call recorded in the trip record, and her own device track stays within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius throughout. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) to (c) are therefore made out on the face of the evidence, and the driver's case rests on his own arrival and dwell arithmetic under POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-07 as set out above, which stand unless the judge finds POL-NS-04 displaces them.
